scope: Instruction/policy-conditioned full-duplex turn-management binding for the existing deterministic VoicePacketCortex only

current_source_observation.finding: The current packet cortex has deterministic endpoint/overlap/barge-in and WAIT/BACKCHANNEL/ANSWER event primitives, but no explicit turn-policy object/config input and no current PacketTurnPolicy type. Existing tests prove primitive trajectories, not a same-history policy-only intervention.

prior_fence_refresh.meaning: The old research-claim instruction not to mutate/redispatch WP900 while its runtime work was active is no longer the live blocker at this observed head. It does not grant product mutation authority for this voice-policy boundary.

implementation_contract: Refresh current main and resolve the current legal semantic/mutation owner before changing product source.
First search for an already-existing authoritative turn-policy/config surface upstream of VoicePacketCortex. If one exists, bind and test it instead of creating a duplicate abstraction.

If no explicit policy input exists and the mutation slot is free, add only the smallest immutable/serializable policy binding at the existing authoritative turn-control boundary. Do not create a second turn FSM, cortex, state store, output queue, cancellation authority or VoiceIntent authority.
Preserve immediate user barge-in cancellation as a mandatory invariant; it must not become an optional policy knob.

Build a deterministic matched-history PFD test: same VoiceSessionCapsule semantics, same pre-intervention state hash, same subsequent VoiceInputPacket sequence/timing; vary exactly one policy dimension.
Require a behaviorally meaningful expected trajectory delta such as WAIT versus BACKCHANNEL at the admitted controller boundary, with exact first-divergence and event/output trajectory hashes.
Require same-policy repeated controls to produce stable hashes and require the policy value to be provenance-bound so metadata-only no-op policy changes cannot pass.
No external model API/network call is permitted for this packet discriminator.

If an existing source boundary cannot support a true policy-only intervention without broad redesign, stop and return REVIEW_ONLY with the exact missing dependency instead of opening architecture breadth.

acceptance_discriminator.PFD3: identical subsequent sensory/input packets and timing
acceptance_discriminator.PFD4: expected event/output trajectory changes at a named causal divergence point
acceptance_discriminator.PFD5: repeat controls stable; policy provenance bound; network calls zero

falsifiers: Input packets/history/timing differ between arms before the claimed policy effect.
Policy metadata changes but the required behavior trajectory does not.
A second turn/cancellation/state authority is introduced.
Mandatory user-barge-in cancellation can be disabled by policy.
External model/API access is required to make the deterministic discriminator pass.
Same-policy repeated controls are nondeterministic without an admitted source.
next_exact_action: Trigger4 resolves the current single turn-control owner and either binds an existing explicit policy surface or implements the smallest noncompeting immutable policy input plus deterministic PFD0-PFD5 regression. Trigger7 then consumes the exact source/test outcome.
